command:
set +e
echo "### FreeType CMake"; grep -n "freetype\|Trigonometry\|CurveBounds\|add_library\|target_link" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeType/CMakeLists.txt | head -30
echo "### CurveBounds"; grep -n "nid_postfix\|#include" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeType/src/CurveBounds.cpp
echo "### GuestFreeType.hpp head"; sed -n 1,40p core/libs/prx/libSceFreeType/include/GuestFreeType.hpp
echo "### Ot stubs"; for n in L1uHkWTazkI dojyaLKzKN0 3WpTQrvGUcU 0Aal-TIC4so; do grep -n -B6 -A1 "\"$n\"" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/Export.cpp; done
echo "### Ot Export head"; sed -n 1,30p core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/Export.cpp
echo "### Ot hpp"; cat core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/libSceFreeTypeOt.hpp; ls core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt/include 2>/dev/null
echo "### Ot debt"; cat docs/dev/debt/libSceFreeTypeOt.md
echo "### tests for trig / iostream_category"; grep -rln "FT_Sin\|FT_Vector_Unit\|iostream_category" core/libs tests 2>/dev/null | head
echo "### libc unexpected/terminate"; grep -rn "unexpected\|_ZSt9terminatev" core/libs/prx/libc --include=*.cpp | head -10
echo "### LibcInternal tests dir & AlignedNew test"; grep -n "aligned\|AlignedNew\|add_test" core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/CMakeLists.txt | head -20
echo "### libc CxxAbiSupport 95-110"; sed -n 1,20p core/libs/prx/libc/src/CxxAbiSupport.cpp; sed -n 95,110p core/libs/prx/libc/src/CxxAbiSupport.cpp
grep -rn "iostream_category" core/libs/prx/libc/include | head
echo "### overlap"
nums=$(for p in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/boykopovar/AnyPS5/pulls?state=open&per_page=100&page=$p" | python3 -c 'import json,sys;[print(x["number"]) for x in json.load(sys.stdin)]'; done)
echo "open: $(echo $nums | wc -w)"
for n in $nums; do git fetch -q --depth=1 origin +refs/pull/$n/head:refs/pr/$n 2>/dev/null; done
for n in $nums; do
  git rev-parse -q --verify refs/pr/$n >/dev/null || continue
  d=$(git diff HEAD refs/pr/$n -- core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal docs/dev/debt/libSceFreeTypeOt.md 2>/dev/null)
  for k in L1uHkWTazkI dojyaLKzKN0 3WpTQrvGUcU 0Aal-TIC4so V23qt24VPVs Trigonometry CurveBounds iostream_category; do
    echo "$d" | grep "^[+-]" | grep -q -- "$k" && echo "PR $n touches $k"
  done
  s=$(git diff --stat HEAD refs/pr/$n -- core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt | tail -1); [ -n "$s" ] && echo "PR $n FreeTypeOt: $s"
done
echo overlap-done
